headword: {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}
reading: ちょうざいやっきょく

definitions.explanation: A pharmacy licensed to fill doctors' prescriptions and prepare prescription medicine, as opposed to a drugstore that mainly sells over-the-counter products and daily goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I hand in my prescription at the dispensing pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I picked up my medicine at a nearby dispensing pharmacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After being examined at the hospital, you get your medicine at a dispensing pharmacy.

notes:
A pharmacy licensed to prepare and dispense prescription drugs. Since the spread of ⟦{医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}→医薬分業：29888_iyakubungyou⟧ (separation of prescribing and dispensing), most prescriptions are filled at these rather than inside hospitals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to get medicine at a dispensing pharmacy
- {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work at a dispensing pharmacy
- {門前|もんぜん}⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧: a pharmacy located just outside a hospital

- ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧: pharmacy — general term; may or may not fill prescriptions
